theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- rewrite the divisibility condition as a modular equality
  have h₁ : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    simpa [ModEq, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] using Iff.rfl
  -- the key congruence: 2³ ≡ 1 (mod 7)
  have h₂ : (2 ^ 3) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
    dsimp [ModEq]
    norm_num
  -- from h₂ we get that any power of 2 with exponent a multiple of 3 is ≡ 1
  have hpow : ∀ k, (2 ^ (3 * k)) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := fun k => by
    simpa [pow_mul] using h₂.pow k
  -- split n as 3·(n/3) + n%3
  have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_mul_div_add_mod n 3).symm
  -- reduce the exponent modulo 3
  have hred : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
    have : (2 ^ n) = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3)) := by
      simpa [hdecomp, pow_add, pow_mul] using rfl
    calc
      (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) * (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
        simpa [this]
      _ ≡ (1 : ℕ) * (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
        simpa [hpow (n / 3)] using (ModEq.mul_left _ (hpow (n / 3)))
      _ ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
        simpa using (ModEq.one_mul _)
  -- now the condition becomes a check on the remainder n % 3
  have hcase : (2 ^ (n % 3)) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    have h0 : (2 ^ 0) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [ModEq]; norm_num
    have h1 : (2 ^ 1) ≡ (2 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [ModEq]; norm_num
    have h2 : (2 ^ 2) ≡ (4 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      dsimp [ModEq]; norm_num
    have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    rcases Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (by decide) with hlt
    have : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      interval_cases (n % 3) <;> tauto
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases this with h0' | h1' | h2'
      · exact h0'
      · have : (2 : ℕ) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
          simpa [h1] using h
        have : (2 : ℕ) % 7 = 1 % 7 := this
        norm_num at this
      · have : (4 : ℕ) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
          simpa [h2] using h
        have : (4 : ℕ) % 7 = 1 % 7 := this
        norm_num at this
    · intro hrem
      rcases hrem with rfl
      simpa using h0
  -- combine the reductions
  have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] ↔ n % 3 = 0 := by
    simpa [hred] using hcase
  -- finally translate the remainder condition to divisibility by 3
  simpa [ModEq, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] using
    (show (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] ↔ 3 ∣ n from
      (this.trans <| by
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero (by
            simpa [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd] using h))
        · intro h
          rcases Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h with ⟨k, hk⟩
          have : n % 3 = 0 := by
            simpa [hk] using Nat.mod_mul_left_mod _ _ _
          exact this)))
